info.description: API REST para el manejo de inventarios multi-tenant
info.title: Motico API

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token

get.description: Get paginated list of categories for the tenant

post.description: Create a new category for the tenant

get.description: Get a specific category by its ID

patch.description: Update specific fields of a category (partial update)

get.description: Get paginated list of products for the tenant

post.description: Create a new product for the tenant

get.description: Get a specific product by its ID

patch.description: Update specific fields of a product (partial update)

get.description: Get stock information for a specific product

put.description: Set the stock quantity for a product

patch.description: Add or subtract quantity from stock (amount can be positive or negative)

get.description: Get paginated list of stores for the tenant

post.description: Create a new store for the tenant

get.description: Get a specific store by its ID

patch.description: Update specific fields of a store (partial update)

get.description: Get paginated list of transfers for the tenant

post.description: Create a new transfer between stores

get.description: Get a specific transfer by its ID

put.description: Update an existing transfer (only pending transfers can be updated)

delete.description: Delete a transfer by ID (only pending transfers can be deleted)

patch.description: Cancel a transfer and release reserved stock
Mark a transfer as completed and update stock

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
